status_note: Attempted 2026-10-04 on Kaggle: the model requires bfloat16; float16 on T4 dies with a CUDA device-side assert during generation, and device_map=cpu does not help because the qwen-tts package moves its code predictor to CUDA internally. Kaggle GPU shapes (T4/P100) and the local GTX 1080 are all pre-Ampere without bf16. German clips (Qwen3-TTS covers de) stay pending bf16 hardware (RTX 30xx+/A100/cloud).
